answer_1.quote: We explored multiple ways to instantiate each approach, which we will now describe in more detail. We consider a baseline seq2seq approach and then explore how to augment it using contextualised representations from language models.
answer_1.outputs: formal intermediate representation and probability answer

answer_2.quote: We evaluate two aspects of the performance. The surface evaluation simply checks the correctness of the generated representation against the formal ground-truth representation. We report the accuracy (representations need to match exactly), as well as the F1 score, which also rewards the representations that are partially correct. The execution-level evaluation first passes the generated representation to the solver, then compares its output to that of the ground-truth answer (probability). We report the accuracy, in which the probabilities rounded to four decimal digits need to match exactly, as well as the mean-absolute error (MAE) to summarise the magnitude of prediction error.
